title: Netflix Confirms Production and Cast of 'Materesa' (WT) by ‘Queen of Tears’ Director and ‘The East Palace’ Writers
summary: Netflix has confirmed the production and cast of its new Korean series Materesa (WT), a story about a cold-blooded criminal psychologist and professor named Ma Teresa (NANA), who investigates unsolved murder cases.
body_markdown:
Entertainment


01 September 2026


Global


South Korea


Link copied to clipboard


Netflix has confirmed the production and cast of its new Korean series


Materesa


(WT), a story about a cold-blooded criminal psychologist and professor named Ma Teresa (NANA), who investigates unsolved murder cases. She's joined by her assistant Park Seol (Kim Dan), whose innocent looks hide a secret, and her long-time friend and prosecutor Yoo A-ram (Jung Gun-joo), as the three come to confront long-hidden truths and emotions.


When Ma Teresa is asked to consult on high-profile cold-case murder investigations, her assistant, Park Seol, is eager to help, craving her attention. Meanwhile, Yoo A-ram is wary of Park Seol lingering by Teresa’s side. As Ma Teresa interrogates criminals to uncover clues and comes closer to the long-desired truth, she finds herself swept up in unexpected emotions.


Materesa


(WT) is directed by Jang Young-woo (


[Queen of Tears](https://www.netflix.com/title/81707950) ,


[Bulgasal: Immortal Souls](https://www.netflix.com/title/81483462) ) and written by Kwon So-ra and Seo Jea-won (


[The East Palace](https://www.netflix.com/title/81778702) ). Together, they weave a thriller around cold murder cases with subtle and intensifying emotions between the characters.


NANA (


[Mask Girl](https://www.netflix.com/title/81516491) ,


[Glitch](https://www.netflix.com/title/81340251) ) takes on the role of Ma Teresa, bringing both her character's hardened exterior and her complex inner turmoil to life as she investigates cold-case murders while carrying old trauma. Rising star Kim Dan (


[The Winning Try](https://www.netflix.com/title/82037349) ) plays her assistant, Park Seol, whose easy smile hides a secret and an unpredictable edge. Jung Gun-joo (


[Mercy for None](https://www.netflix.com/title/81702777) ) stars as prosecutor Yoo A-ram, Ma Teresa’s long-time friend, bringing quiet depth to the tangled relationships at the story's center.


Materesa


(WT) will present a novel story that delves into high-profile cold-case murders as the characters inch toward the truth — and toward each other — only on Netflix.
